source.paraphrase: Keys never live in source; they arrive from the wallet or the environment.

invariants.why: A secret in source ships into git, logs, and every worktree; rotation then means rewriting history. Static syntax cannot prove values or provenance across helpers and imports; see BACKLOG.md for this rule's uncaught flow and warning default.
invariants.fixHint: Build keypairs from the wallet or the environment at runtime.
invariants.avoid: Base64 of the same bytes in source, or a JSON file with the key committed next to the code.

source.paraphrase: Key material is never logged, asked for, or stored.

invariants.why: A leftover log prints key material to whatever stdout production captures. Static syntax cannot prove values or provenance across helpers and imports; see BACKLOG.md for this rule's uncaught flow and warning default.
invariants.fixHint: Log ids and balances, never mnemonics, secret keys, or seed phrases. Never ask for them either.
invariants.avoid: Debug-level logging of the same values: debug output ships too.

source.paraphrase: Browser storage holds preferences, never key material.

invariants.why: Browser storage is readable by any script on the page, including an injected one. Static syntax cannot prove values or provenance across helpers and imports; see BACKLOG.md for this rule's uncaught flow and warning default.
invariants.fixHint: Keep keys in the wallet. Store only preferences and public state in browser storage.
invariants.avoid: Encrypting the key with a password that sits next to it in the same storage.
